# CYTOKINES (ED, 2WK, 6M)

## Prep data 
```{r}
# load cytokine data
cytokine_data_full <- read_csv("Data/Cytokine Data/Data Files/Cytokines_1422.csv",
                          show_col_types = FALSE)

cytokine_data_full <- cytokine_data_full %>%
  mutate(
    PID = as.character(PID), 
    Timepoint = case_when(
      Time == "T0" ~ "ED",
      Time == "T1" ~ "WK2",
      Time %in% c("T2", "T3") ~ "M6",
      TRUE ~ Time),
    Batch = factor(BATCH),
    Plate = gsub("\\)", "", Plate_new),
    Plate = factor(Plate)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-Plate_new)

```

## Batch effects 
```{r}
# cytokines to test
cytokines_to_test <- c("IFN_gama_log", "IL_10_log", "IL_6_log", "IL_8_log", "TNF_alpha_log")


cytokine_batch_plate_summary <- map_dfr(cytokines_to_test, function(cyt) {
  
  df <- cytokine_data_full %>%
    dplyr::select(all_of(cyt), Batch, Plate, Timepoint) %>%
    na.omit()
  
  # fit model
  fit <- lm(reformulate(c("Batch", "Plate", "Timepoint"), response = cyt), data = df)
  
  # ANOVA 
  aov_tbl <- anova(fit)
  
  # extract sums of squares
  ss_total <- sum(aov_tbl$`Sum Sq`)
  
  # helper function
  get_term_stats <- function(term_name) {
      ss <- aov_tbl[term_name, "Sum Sq"]
      p  <- aov_tbl[term_name, "Pr(>F)"]
      df <- aov_tbl[term_name, "Df"]
      tibble(
        Term = term_name,
        p.value = p,
        df = df,
        partial_R2 = ss / ss_total)
  }
  
  term_stats <- bind_rows(
    get_term_stats("Batch"),
    get_term_stats("Plate"))
  
  # model-level stats
  model_stats <- glance(fit)
  
  # data-level stats
  data_stats <- tibble(
    Cytokine = cyt,
    n = nrow(df),
    mean = mean(df[[cyt]], na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(df[[cyt]], na.rm = TRUE))
  
  term_stats %>%
    mutate(Cytokine = cyt) %>%
    left_join(data_stats, by = "Cytokine") %>%
    mutate(
      model_R2 = model_stats$r.squared,
      adj_R2 = model_stats$adj.r.squared)
  
}) %>%
  mutate(FDR = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH")) %>%
  arrange(p.value) %>%
  mutate(Test = "ANOVA")


write.csv(cytokine_batch_plate_summary, "Data/Cytokine Data/Analysis Data/Cytokine_Batch_Effect_Summary_3-23-2026.csv")

cytokine_data_adjusted <- cytokine_data_full

for (cyt in cytokines_to_test) {
  
  # define model per cytokine
  # TNF alpha and IL8 were the only cytokines with Batch effects 
  # all cytokines had plate effects 
  if (cyt %in% c("TNF_alpha_log", "IL_8_log")) {
    formula_terms <- c("Plate", "Batch")
  } else {
    formula_terms <- c("Plate")
  }
  
  fit <- lm(reformulate(formula_terms, response = cyt),
            data = cytokine_data_full)
  
  cytokine_data_adjusted[[cyt]] <- resid(fit) + 
    mean(cytokine_data_full[[cyt]], na.rm = TRUE)
}

# check to make sure plate effects removed 
# lm(IL_6_log ~ Plate, data = cytokine_data_adjusted) %>% summary()

```

## Data for analysis
```{r}
# clean up the matrix 
cytokine_matrix_clean <- cytokine_data_adjusted %>%
  dplyr::select(PID, Timepoint, all_of(cytokines_to_test)) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    IFN_gama = IFN_gama_log,
    IL_10 = IL_10_log,
    IL_6 = IL_6_log,
    IL_8 = IL_8_log,
    TNF_alpha = TNF_alpha_log) %>%
  arrange(PID, Timepoint) %>%
  filter(PID %in% PIDs_245_ED6M)

dim(cytokine_matrix_clean) # 475, 7 

length(unique(cytokine_matrix_clean$PID)) # 240

# subset to ED and 6M paired samples in RNA-seq
cytokine_matrix_ED6M <- cytokine_matrix_clean %>%
  filter(
    PID %in% PIDs_245_ED6M,
    Timepoint %in% c("ED", "M6")) %>%
  group_by(PID) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(Timepoint) == 2) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(PID, Timepoint)

dim(cytokine_matrix_ED6M) # 422 x 7 

write.csv(cytokine_matrix_ED6M, "Data/Cytokine Data/Analysis Data/Cytokine_Data_ED6M_422_3-23-2026.csv")

# subset to ED, WK2 and 6M paired samples in RNA-seq
cytokine_matrix_ED2WK6M <- cytokine_matrix_clean %>%
  filter(
    PID %in% PIDs_40_ED2WK6M,
    Timepoint %in% c("ED","WK2","M6")) %>%
  group_by(PID) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(Timepoint) == 3) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(PID, Timepoint)

dim(cytokine_matrix_ED2WK6M) # 51 x 7 

write.csv(cytokine_matrix_ED2WK6M, "Data/Cytokine Data/Analysis Data/Cytokine_Data_ED2WK6M_51_3-23-2026.csv")
```

## Normality 
```{r}
# cytokines in the clean matrix
cytokine_vars <- c("IFN_gama", "IL_10", "IL_6", "IL_8", "TNF_alpha")

# sample set used in the clean adjusted matrix
cytokine_overlap_ids <- cytokine_matrix_clean %>%
  dplyr::select(PID, Timepoint) %>%
  distinct()

# matching raw cytokine data on the exact same PID x Timepoint rows
cytokine_matrix_raw_overlap <- cytokine_data_full %>%
  dplyr::select(PID, Timepoint, all_of(cytokine_vars)) %>%
  semi_join(cytokine_overlap_ids, by = c("PID", "Timepoint")) %>%
  arrange(PID, Timepoint)

# matching adjusted cytokine data
cytokine_matrix_adjusted_overlap <- cytokine_matrix_clean %>%
  dplyr::select(PID, Timepoint, all_of(cytokine_vars)) %>%
  arrange(PID, Timepoint)


summarize_wide_cytokines <- function(df, vars) {
  df %>%
    summarise(
      across(
        all_of(vars),
        list(
          N = ~ sum(is.finite(.x)),
          Mean = ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
          Median = ~ median(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
          SD = ~ sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
          Skewness = ~ e1071::skewness(.x, na.rm = TRUE, type = 2),
          Kurtosis = ~ e1071::kurtosis(.x, na.rm = TRUE, type = 2)),
        .names = "{.col}::{.fn}")) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      everything(),
      names_to = c("Cytokine", ".value"),
      names_sep = "::") %>%
    relocate(Cytokine)
}

# RAW
cytokine_stats_raw <- cytokine_matrix_raw_overlap %>%
  dplyr::select(all_of(cytokine_vars)) %>%
  summarize_wide_cytokines(vars = cytokine_vars) %>%
  mutate(Scale = "Raw") %>%
  relocate(Scale, .after = Cytokine)

# ADJUSTED
cytokine_stats_adjusted <- cytokine_matrix_adjusted_overlap %>%
  dplyr::select(all_of(cytokine_vars)) %>%
  summarize_wide_cytokines(vars = cytokine_vars) %>%
  mutate(Scale = "Log_Adjusted") %>%
  relocate(Scale, .after = Cytokine)

# COMBINED
cytokine_stats_compare <- bind_rows(
  cytokine_stats_raw,
  cytokine_stats_adjusted %>%
  mutate(Scale = factor(Scale, levels = c("Raw", "Log_Adjusted"))) %>%
  arrange(Cytokine, Scale)) %>%
  arrange(Cytokine)

cytokine_stats_compare

write.csv(cytokine_stats_compare, "Data/Cytokine Data/Analysis Data/Cytokine_Data_Stat_Summary_3-23-2026.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```
